svg.text: PROPOSAL SECTION 5 • ZERO MANUAL BOOKKEEPING & AUTOMATED REVENUE SPLIT

Eliminate end-of-month accounting overhead. The moment a student taps their NFC Smart Pass at any turnstile entrance gate, the tuition fee is atomically split into the teacher's payout ledger and the institute account.
Agreed royalty rates, enrolled student counts, gross fee collections, and bank payout statuses

Proposal Policy Section 5 (Automated Revenue Splitting): During teacher onboarding, the administrator sets the agreed percentage split. The instant a student taps their NFC Smart Pass at any gate, the tuition fee is atomically split between the teacher's payout ledger and the institute account, preventing manual disputes and calculation errors.
Unified Tuition Management & NFC Ecosystem (SDGP CS76 - 2026)
